release: Landing redesign: calm premium v2 (PR #42, successor to #41)

rootCauses: components/registration/registration-view.tsx carried the why-join-early section twice, so the campaign contract counted 8 points instead of 4
the v2 phone headline (clamp(2.35rem, 11vw, 3.6rem)) pushed the primary CTA below the fold on 320-390px screens in English
the launch strip's edge bleed used the old page padding, leaving 7px of horizontal overflow at 768px and 200% zoom
fixes: one why-join-early section after the audience cards
phone headline clamp(1.9rem, 8vw, 2.6rem) with a tighter lead
strip bleed aligned with the v2 padding

liveVerification.method: Headless Chromium (Playwright) from the build sandbox: viewport emulation, not physical devices. The sandbox reaches the internet through an agent proxy that intermittently answered 502 for static assets under browser load; those relays were retried transparently and counted (17 retries in the journey run, 0 in the capture run); every asset returned 200 directly. The browser contexts ignore the proxy's interception certificate; TLS to sawwiq.org was verified separately through the sandbox CA bundle (HTTP 200, verify result 0).
liveVerification.captureMatrix: ar and en at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 (light), 390 and 1440 (dark), 720 CSS px at 200% zoom, 390 reduced motion: 0 horizontal overflow, 0 broken images, strip, cohort badge, headline and CTA inside the first viewport on every phone and desktop frame (CTA below the 500px-tall zoom frame, as before); reduced motion reports no running animations; keyboard path strip link → brand → country → locate → language → theme → sign in → CTA, all with a visible outline.
liveVerification.screenshots: docs/upgrades/landing-redesign/live-2026-10-03/*.png (fold frames: ar 390/1440/320, en 390/1440, and the ar 390 join page reached from the CTA); journey.json and capture-report.json hold the measurements
